details.direction: Newlands Main Road → UCT Rugby Fields; 05:15 batch start
details.distanceMethod: The official 2027 Ultra Marathon page states the distance as 56 km. No separately measured distance to the metre is published.
details.attribution: Two Oceans Marathon NPC. The 2027 Ultra Marathon page publishes the start, finish, distance, entry fees, prize money and named route areas but no GPX file and no track-reuse licence, and says a detailed 2027 route map will be made available before the race. The same page also links a static 2026 56 km route-map PDF with an elevation profile; this site links that prior-edition sheet as a reference and does not treat it as 2027 geometry. This site does not draw the course, does not host a track and leaves elevation unknown; a third-party race recap estimates about 700 m of gain in the second half and is labelled as third-party in the body.
